reviews.t: Don't waste your money

reviews.t: Good at first but it won't last
reviews.x: It worked great the first 3 times I used it at about 20 minutes each time. Now the motor just seems really weak. Even when I switched over to the 2nd abrasive attachment that's included the motor is barely powering the device and keep in mind I only use it with the power cord attached. I haven't used it without it. I bought this because I figure the motor should always be fairly strong as long as it's plugged in but it's already failed. Don't buy this because the quality sucks.

reviews.t: It worked FANTASTIC when I first got it
reviews.x: It worked FANTASTIC when I first got it. The battery is rechargeable but the motor of it doesn't hold up well. It can be fully charged and just doesn't work as well as it did when new. Power needs to last longer!

reviews.t: used it with great results 3 or 4 times and then
reviews.x: I'll give it two stars because it works very well- for the short time that it works. I bought one, used it with great results 3 or 4 times and then... it just lost power. By "lost power", I mean that it just no longer would remove any dead skin. I followed the directions, always used it plugged in so I know it wasn't a battery issue. I never pressed too hard, as I understood that would stop the file from working. But, it got to the point that if I *barely touched* my foot, it would stop.

reviews.t: after trying this electric callus remover he was amazed! Everything came with the callus remover including changing ...
reviews.x: My husband has had issues with callus on his feet for years. He was a little reluctant that this little machine was going to help.  But, after trying this electric callus remover he was amazed!  Everything came with the callus remover including changing head & brush to clean it off.  Even the batteries were included.  Very good quality machine and well satisfied.  Everyone needs one of these in their household!

reviews.t: Amazing and effective
reviews.x: With some patience to avoid overdoing it at one time, this callous remover works great.  My initial charge lasted for weeks of twice-a-week use, and though I purchased replacement heads, I haven't worn out the original yet.  Snapping off the head to clean is a breeze, and appreciate the little brush you get to clean out the dead skin.  So far, the quality is outstanding.  Highly recommended.

reviews.t: Husband loves it.
reviews.x: I bought this for my husband for his birthday.  He had callouses on his feet that would crack and bleed.  He says that this is helping tremendously.  He has ugly feet, and this is helping to beautify them. Being corded may make it awkward for some, but it has lots of power and gets the job done.

reviews.t: Wish I knew about this years ago!
reviews.x: Let me start off saying I was skeptical that this callus remover would do a good job. After reading the reviews I decided that I had to give it a try. I couldn't believe how effective it is at removing dry dead skin and calluses. My feet look and feel so smooth. I love this!

reviews.t: helps my heals with the dry skin
reviews.x: This is a great machine. It really helps my heals. I wear sandals almost year round so my heals are really exposed to the dry air a lot. I wish it were a little less expensive for replacement files but other than that its a good machine and helpful. The battery seems to run down fast and it really needs to be plugged in for it to work well. If its not plugged in it seems to keep stopping if any pressure is applied to the file. I've never had a different brand so I have nothing to compare this to

claims.text: Many reviewers say the device works very well and effectively removes dry, cracked skin and calluses, leaving feet smooth and soft.
A common complaint is that the motor loses power or the device stops working after only a few uses or a short time.
Several reviewers report battery or charging problems, including the device failing to charge or not running even when plugged in.
Some reviewers praise the customer service, with one noting a positive experience with a service representative.
A few reviewers mention that the device needs to be fully charged to perform well.
